review_evidence: Whole-checkout survey (find/wc/grep across all 17556 .lean files and 7 non-.lean project files: .gitignore, lakefile.toml, lake-manifest.json, lean-toolchain, LICENSE, NOTICE, README.md) found only standard Lean-project metadata outside .lean files. A corpus-wide grep for theorem|lemma|def|structure|class|instance|inductive|abbrev|example|axiom found 72 .lean files without those keywords; every one of the 72 was read individually: the root DifferentialGeometry.lean is the standard root import aggregator, about 55 are single-line leaf 'import X' modules, and the remainder use export/alias/open or a run_cmd Lean.Elab.Command.liftTermElabM axiom-hygiene check (e.g. Section34PiercingPackageAxioms.lean, Section34VertexPreparationAxioms.lean) or namespace-scoped export/alias re-export facades (e.g. WeakHarnack.lean, SameDimension.lean, DeGiorgi.lean). FILTER-007 places namespace/alias/export/executable-command files outside the unilateral pure-import-aggregator class, so none of the 72 qualify for hard exclusion; all are retained as navigation/aliasing/verification content.
This unit's file list intersects the flagged set at: ['DifferentialGeometry/Topology/SphereSeparation/SameDimension.lean']. Each was individually read: content described in the survey note; retained.
summary: Surveyed the full checkout (directory layout, file-type census, corpus-wide grep survey, and individual reads of every flagged file). This unit (DifferentialGeometry/Topology/@subtrees/6, 165 files) is consistent with that survey; no file in it lacks formal mathematical content that would justify exclusion under FILTER-002/FILTER-004/FILTER-007.
